races.paceDynamic: Two B Tanned and Eazy On The Eye will contest the early lead, with Two B Tanned returning from a 200-day break likely to show early pace before potentially weakening. Eazy On The Eye has shown consistent front-running ability and should take them along at a solid clip. The prominent racers Swift Salian, Harry The Rogue, Ayr Poet, and Dwindling Funds will sit just off the pace, creating a competitive middle pack. This honest gallop with multiple pace angles should set up perfectly for the hold-up horses to deliver late kicks, particularly those with proven finishing ability over this trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves honest but sustainable between the two leaders
scenarios.body: The pace will be strong enough to set up the race for closers but not so fierce as to completely stop the kick out of them. Horses like Madame De Sevigne, Flying Fletcher, and Detective can use their hold-up style to maximum effect.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Rank Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Eazy On The Eye gets an easier lead than expected with Two B Tanned not firing fresh
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more tactical, allowing the front-runners and prominent racers to control their own destiny. Swift Salian's recent good form and Harry The Rogue's consistency become crucial advantages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: True Staying Test
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go hard from the start creating a genuine speed duel
scenarios.body: The pace becomes searingly fast, turning this into a test of stamina where only the most genuine stayers survive. The race falls apart for many, leaving it to the horses with the best recent form and fitness.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Two B Tanned's absence tells and Eazy On The Eye gets intimidated or restrained early
scenarios.body: The pace becomes crawling, turning into a sprint finish where tactical position matters more than running style. Horses drawn well who can get handy regardless of preferred style gain a major advantage.

Swift Salian's early position critical given his current form suggests he's the one to beat
Any market moves for the Goldie runners given the trainer's good recent strike rate

races.paceDynamic: Sovereign Bright will lead uncontested from the gates with no other natural front-runners in the field, setting a controlled gallop that suits her stamina-laden pedigree. The prominent runners Donna Nook, Polygram, Glorious Kitty and Salaria will track in second flight but none are aggressive early types, allowing the pace to remain manageable. This creates a tactical race where the large contingent of hold-up horses (Epidavros, Lady Dora Mae, Naturalia, Bearin Up, Samra Star, Fille Imbassee, Krissy, Storm On Jura) will be relying on a sprint finish from off the pace. The uncontested lead and moderate early gallop strongly favours front-running and prominent types who can dictate terms.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Sovereign Bright gets an easy lead and times her effort correctly
scenarios.body: The 3-year-old faces no early pressure and can control the race from pillar to post, with Sean Bowen able to dictate fractions that play to her strengths. Her recent form shows she thrives when allowed to dominate, and the weight relief makes her tough to peg back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can get into perfect stalking position behind Sovereign Bright
scenarios.body: Glorious Kitty or Donna Nook can track the leader closely and have enough left to sweep past in the final furlong when the pace quickens. Their positioning advantage over the held-up brigade proves decisive in a race where the early pace doesn't collapse.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Rallies
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong or Sovereign Bright ties up late
scenarios.body: Lady Dora Mae or Bearin Up can close from off the pace as the early leaders pay for their exertions. The 3-year-old weight allowances become crucial as the race develops into a stamina test over the extended trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Sovereign Bright goes too fast early trying to dominate completely
scenarios.body: The entire field compresses in the final two furlongs as the leaders stop, allowing a closer like Epidavros or Krissy to pick up the pieces. This requires the front-runner to misjudge the pace significantly given her tactical advantage.

watchPoints.text: Sovereign Bright's early fractions will determine the entire race outcome - if she gets soft sectionals she becomes very hard to pass
Watch for any prominent runner trying to pressure Sovereign Bright early as this could change the tactical complexion completely

races.paceDynamic: Night Breeze will likely lead from the start with no other confirmed front runners in this field. Hamlet's Night and Eroico should press forward early, creating a modest gallop through the middle stages at this staying distance. The lack of natural pace setters means the early tempo will be sustainable rather than fierce, allowing the prominent runners to dictate terms. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed who can position close to the pace, as they'll have first run on a field loaded with hold-up horses who may struggle for clear runs in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace stays moderate with Night Breeze leading unchallenged
scenarios.body: Night Breeze maintains control while Hamlet's Night and Eroico travel comfortably in behind, then the front three pull clear as the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground. The pace-prominent brigade simply have too much tactical advantage over this distance.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses go too fast early or tire in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Fast Fred or Princess Niyla produce strong finishes from the back as the early leaders weaken, benefiting from the extra fitness edge their recent runs provide. The hold-up horses finally get the race shape they need with weakening pace-setters.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and turns into a sprint
scenarios.body: Rising Sky's tactical speed allows him to quicken off the steady pace, while the true stayers get caught out by the change of tempo. Fresh horses with turn of foot benefit from the tactical nature.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Layoff Returns Fire
scenarios.trigger: If Motawaared or Eroico show sharp improvement returning from breaks
scenarios.body: The long absence works in their favour as they show renewed enthusiasm, taking advantage of a pace collapse in the final stages. Their class edges through despite the time away from action.

Hamlet's Night's early positioning behind Night Breeze will indicate tactical intentions and confidence levels from Jason Hart
Motawaared and Letsbefrank both returning from 200+ day breaks need to show early enthusiasm to suggest fitness is there
Rising Sky's ability to travel smoothly in the early stages will determine if the 30-day freshening break has worked positively

This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late acceleration, as the early pace will set up perfectly for closers like Abduction, Little Empire and Persuasion.

races.paceDynamic: Senor Cortez will take the field along as the sole confirmed front runner, with St Faz and Talismans Time likely to track him in second and third positions early. The relatively small field and lack of pace pressure should allow Senor Cortez to dictate terms and create a sustainable gallop rather than a punishing tempo. With five hold-up horses (Whimsy, Simple Star, Mountain Road, Alther Walden, Trojan Sun) needing to be wound up from off the pace, this race sets up perfectly for prominent runners and those who can travel kindly in the first half of the field. The tactical verdict strongly favours prominent runners who can position close to the pace without having to make up significant ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Senor Cortez sets a steady tempo without serious early pressure from the prominent runners.
scenarios.body: The front three get first run on the field and the hold-up horses have too much ground to make up over this shorter staying trip. Senor Cortez and St Faz benefit most from being able to control their own destiny from the front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Creates Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If St Faz and Talismans Time put serious pressure on Senor Cortez from early in the race.
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainable for the front three, allowing the hold-up horses to sweep past them in the final two furlongs. Simple Star and Alther Walden are perfectly positioned to capitalize on a collapse.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Perfect Position Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Talismans Time tracks the pace perfectly without engaging until late.
scenarios.body: Edward Bethell's runner gets the best of both worlds - close enough to the pace to not give away lengths but not committed to the speed duel. Talismans Time's class tells with a perfectly-timed challenge that the pure hold-up horses cannot match.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong and all the prominent runners tie up badly.
scenarios.body: One of the deep closers produces a spectacular finish to sweep past the entire field in the final furlong. Mountain Road's long absence could work in his favor if Jim Goldie has him primed for a big run fresh.

watchPoints.text: Mountain Road returning after 582 days off - fitness versus fresh legs could be decisive either way.
Senor Cortez getting an easy lead early - if not pressured his sustained gallop could prove unbeatable.
Talismans Time's 246-day absence with Edward Bethell - trainer form suggests readiness but stamina questions after layoff.
St Faz and Simple Star both in excellent recent form - whoever gets better position tracking the pace holds advantage.
The five hold-up horses creating traffic problems - early positioning crucial to avoid getting boxed in.

races.paceDynamic: Ziggy's Triton stands alone as the confirmed front runner and will face no pressure through the early stages, allowing him to dictate a comfortable gallop. Mon Na Slieve, I'm Next, and Archduke Ferdinand are the prominent runners who will track behind but none are aggressive pace forcers. This creates a sustainable tempo that builds gradually rather than a fierce early burn. The absence of pace pressure strongly favours horses who can travel kindly in the first half and produce their best effort late, making this a race for prominent runners and hold-up horses with a strong finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Ziggy's Triton gets easy fractions and isn't caught napping late
scenarios.body: The pace-setter gets perfect conditions to showcase his stamina and the hold-up horses find the tempo too honest to make serious inroads. Ziggy's Triton capitalizes on the tactical advantage while I'm Next benefits from tracking the winner.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the sustainable pace sets up perfectly for closers with tactical speed
scenarios.body: The honest gallop allows the best hold-up horses to wind up from the back and time their challenge to perfection. Albegone and Montezuma find the race run to suit their style completely.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If I'm Next or Mon Na Slieve kick clear approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: The well-positioned prominent runners get first run on the leader and have enough in reserve to hold off the closers. I'm Next's recent good form and tactical position prove decisive in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise from Back
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and a big-priced closer gets a dream run
scenarios.body: The tempo becomes so steady that it turns into a sprint finish where the freshest horse with the best turn of foot prevails. Knicks or Arnhem benefit from the crawling pace and shock connections.
